notes.title: Plan to add a Hard Mode and New Anomalies
notes.notes:
[h3]Plan to add a "Hard Mode"

Hi everyone~ I'm Lokin.[/h3][h3]Some people say that this game is too boring and too easy, and the fixed number of anomalies in each chapter is too predictable.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]So, I plan to add a "hard mode" that includes:[/h3][h3]- Different game loops: Anomalies in the same room will appear randomly in all chapters, for example, anomalies from the original Chapter 3 may appear in Chapter 1[/h3][h3]- 6 new anomalies per room(these anomalies are harder or scarier)[/h3][h3]- Boss levels will remain the same, just let me know what you think about them[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]If you have other ideas or comments, please let me know in the comments.[/h3]

notes.title: Postponed and tentatively scheduled to be released on January 10, 2025.
notes.notes:
Sorry for the players who are looking forward to the release of the game.
But after seeing the experiences of players in the previous demo version,
I think the current atmosphere and fun of the game are not enough.
I hope that when the game is released, players can feel more interesting and shocking.
I also don’t want to be riddled with multiplayer bugs at launch like the previous game.
Therefore, the game will be delayed by one month and is tentatively scheduled to be released on January 10, 2025.

Lokin

notes.title: (For Influencers) Looking for gameplay footage for School 666 Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
(For Influencers) Looking for gameplay footage for School 666 Steam Next Fest!

Steam Next Fest is coming soon, and the "School 666" Steam page will broadcast demo gameplay.
Any influencer is interested in filming a ~5-20 minute demo gameplay video and letting me put it on the Steam page?
The influencer need to have at least 5k subscribers or followers on YouTube/Twitch/Bilibili/Tiktok.
Video languages need to be English/Mandarin/Japanese.
You can promote your video by displaying your name, logo, links, etc.
The video should contain a normal play through of the "School 666" demo.
It can be a single player or multiplayer game.

The game demo can be downloaded directly from School 666 on Steam.
Different live main videos will be played in a loop.
Steam Next Fest will be held from October 14th to 21st.
Videos may be cut to reduce boring scenes.

If you are interested you can contact me via discord or email.
